system_requirements.Processor: 4 core CPU or better – Some examples (but not limited to): AMD FX-6300, Intel Core i5-4430, Intel Core i5-2320, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
system_requirements.Graphics: A gaming graphics card with at least 4GB of DEDICATED memory – Some examples (but not limited to): Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon 570 or better
system_requirements.Additional Notes: A physical PC running windows is required. A PC emulation on a MAC or other types of Virtual Machines are not supported.
